## loader

- `liquid-loader` (shader) A glass circle filling with sloshing liquid, two waves rolling across its surface and bubbles rising, then draining to fill again. Overlay. Presets: With background, Potion, Lime, Still at half. Tags: loader, progress, liquid, water, fill, ui, overlay, loop.
- `glow-ring-spinner` (shader) A ring of light sweeping round with a soft glowing gradient tail, its tail stretching and shrinking as it turns. Overlay. Presets: With background, Sunset, Thin, Light card. Tags: loader, spinner, ring, glow, neon, ui, overlay.
- `metaball-loader` (shader) Gooey blobs chasing each other round a circle, stretching apart and merging back together as they pass. Overlay. Presets: With background, Mercury, Lava, Few. Tags: loader, spinner, metaball, goo, blob, playful, overlay.
- `flame-loader` (shader) A progress bar that burns along its length: the filled part glows like embers under flames, tallest at the leading edge, sparks flying off it. Overlay. Presets: With background, Blue flame, Tall flames, Still at two thirds. Tags: loader, progress, bar, fire, flames, overlay, loop.
- `spinner` (vector) An arc chasing its tail: the classic indeterminate loader. Tags: loader, ui, minimal.
- `bouncing-dots` (vector) Three dots hopping in turn, for typing indicators and loaders. Tags: loader, chat, typing, ui.
- `pulse-ping` (vector) Rings radiating from a dot, like a live indicator or radar ping. Tags: live, notification, location, status.
- `equalizer` (vector) Audio level bars dancing, for now-playing badges and voice states. Tags: music, audio, voice, now-playing.
- `progress-ring` (vector) A ring filling up to a percentage while the number counts with it. Tags: progress, kpi, dashboard, loader.
- `upload-card` (vector) An image upload card whose progress bar fills as the percentage counts to 100%, then the placeholder cross-fades into the finished picture with a check, and resets. Takes text. Words go in `label`. Presets: Dark, Ocean. Tags: upload, progress, image, file, ui, loader.
- `battery-charge` (vector) A battery filling cell by cell as its percentage counts up and the bolt pulses, flashing when it is full. Presets: Light, Low power. Tags: electric, battery, charging, loader, progress, ui, icon.
- `chomp-loader` (vector) A chomping pixel mouth munching along a row of dots between maze walls, as a looping loader. Presets: Ghostly, Light. Tags: pixel, retro, loader, arcade, game, 8-bit, loop.
- `pixel-snake-loader` (vector) A pixel snake running laps round the edge of a phone-LCD board a cell at a time, eating the food in its path, as a looping loader. Presets: Neon, Light. Tags: pixel, retro, loader, snake, game, lcd, 8-bit, loop.
- `bubble-pop-loader` (vector) A loader of four bubbles inflating in turn and popping into droplets, over and over. Presets: Mint, Dark, Candy. Tags: bubble, loader, loading, spinner, ui, playful.
- `skeleton-shimmer` (vector) A skeleton placeholder card (avatar, lines, picture block) with a shimmer of light sweeping across it while content loads. Presets: Dark, Warm. Tags: loader, skeleton, placeholder, shimmer, ui, card.
- `progress-bar` (vector) A striped progress bar filling to a value while its percentage counts up, the stripes marching all the while. Takes text. Words go in `label`. Presets: Dark, Success, Plain. Tags: loader, progress, bar, upload, ui, percent.
- `indeterminate-bar` (vector) A Material-style indeterminate progress bar: two segments racing across the track, one long and one short. Presets: Dark, Thick. Tags: loader, progress, bar, material, ui, minimal.
- `step-progress` (vector) A four-step stepper filling in turn: each step turns solid with a check and the line to the next one fills. Takes text. Words go in `labels`. Presets: Dark, Onboarding. Tags: loader, stepper, progress, checkout, onboarding, ui.
- `circle-dots-loader` (vector) Dots chasing each other round a circle, bunching and spreading as they go, each with a fading trail. Presets: Dark, No trail. Tags: loader, spinner, dots, ui, minimal.

- `skeleton-hand-loader` (vector) A bony skeleton hand drumming its fingers on a table one after another, little finger to index, waiting impatiently. Presets: Dark, Glow bones. Tags: loader, horror, halloween, skeleton, hands, bones, waiting, impatient.
